verdict.rationale: ELSTER documents a sanctioned delegation rail on three fronts. Powers of attorney (Vollmachten) can be filed electronically with the tax office (elster-docs-4), which authorizes representatives to act for the company. Any ELSTER-supporting tax software can transmit through the same channel (elster-docs-2, elster-supp-2). Organisations can also name mailbox representatives (Postfachvertreter) (elster-docs-17). Missing for 10: detailed docs on how authorized representatives or tax advisers act on the company's behalf (scope, roles, revocation), a provider-registration or authorization process for software vendors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
